messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into German, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE German line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
denn jener Kaiser, der dort oben regiert, weil ich seinem Gesetz rebellisch war, er will nicht, dass jemand durch mich in seine Stadt kommt.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑German Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (truth‑condition) | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (DE → EN) | Status | |-------------|------------------------------------------|----------------------|----------------------------|--------| | ché | causal conjunction “for” / “because” | denn | “because/for” | OK | | quello | demonstrative “that” (masc.) | jener | “that (masc.)” | OK | | imperador | sovereign ruler, emperor | Kaiser | “emperor” | OK | | che | relative pronoun introducing clause | der | “who/that” (masc.) | OK | | là | adverb of place “there” | dort | “there” | OK | | sù | adverb of direction “up/above” | oben | “above” | OK | | regna | verb “reigns” (present) | regiert | “reigns” | OK | | perch' | causal conjunction “because” | weil | “because” | OK | | i' | 1st‑person singular pronoun “I” | ich | “I” | OK | | fu' | copular verb “was” (past) | war | “was” | OK | | ribellante | adjective “rebellious” | rebellisch | “rebellious” | OK | | a | preposition “to” (marks target of rebellion) | — *(case expressed by “seinem”)* | — | UNNECESSARY | | la | definite article (fem.) part of “la sua legge” | — *(possessive case expressed by “seinem”)* | — | UNNECESSARY | | sua | possessive adjective “his” (fem.) | seinem | “his” (dative) | OK | | legge | noun “law” (fem.) | Gesetz | “law” | OK | | non | negation particle “not” | nicht | “not” | OK | | vuol | volitional verb “wills / wants” | will | “wants / will” | OK | | che | complementiser “that” (introducing content clause) | dass | “that” | OK | | 'n | preposition “in/into” | in | “in/into” | OK | | sua | possessive adjective “his” (fem.) | seine | “his” (acc.) | OK | | città | noun “city” (fem.) | Stadt | “city” | OK | | per | preposition “through” | durch | “through” | OK | | me | pronoun “me” (object) | mich | “me” | OK | | si | impersonal pronoun “one” (subject of subjunctive) | jemand | “someone / one” | OK | | vegna | verb “should come” (subjunctive) | kommt | “comes / should come” | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY:** `a`, `la` – the Italian preposition and article are not realized as separate words in German; their function is absorbed by the dative case of the possessive adjective *seinem*. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.
